newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia Sugar lists on Lusaka exchange.
newsitem.headline: Zambia Sugar lists on Lusaka exchange.

text.p: Zambia Sugar Plc was on Friday listed on the Lusaka Stock Exchange (LuSE), bringing to five the number of listed companies, exchange manager Charles Mate said.
It is the second company to be listed on the exchange this month after Farmers House, a property investment company, was listed on September 10.
Other listed companies include Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM), Chilanga Cement and Rothmans.
Zambia Sugar is the sole sugar producer in Zambia.
Its major shareholders are Tate & Lyle Plc, which owns about 40 percent of the company's stock, and the Commonwealth Development Corp (CDC), which owns 31 percent.
The Zambian Privatisation Trust Fund, which holds the government shares in the company, and the CDC last month offered to the public 164,473,609 ordinary shares each in Zambia Sugar.
Mate said the offer was "overwhelmingly successful and over-subscribed".
"Prior to this offer, the total number of shareholders in Zambia Sugar was around 575 and the public offer has increased this by around 2,000," he said.
